quotes.text: 501.    LA SEMANA PASADA, DEL……...........… AL……..…., ¿TUVO UD. ALGÚN TRABAJO? (Sin contar los quehaceres del hogar)
546. ¿QUÉ ESTUVO HACIENDO LA SEMANA PASADA: ... Quehaceres del hogar? ............................. 5

assessments.reasoning: Question 501 defines employment/work ('TRABAJO') by explicitly instructing to exclude household chores ('Sin contar los quehaceres del hogar'). In addition, unpaid domestic tasks ('Quehaceres del hogar') are placed in Question 546 as a category for non-working/inactive status rather than incorporated into the definition of economic activity or work. Thus, the definition of the activity category does not include unpaid domestic and care work, and explicitly excludes it.
